title: Aggregate evidence and enforce deterministic/privileged/benchmark outcome semantics
commit_subject: Add fail-closed evidence reducer for the verification matrix

deliverables.note: The plan references this reducer as `evidence-reduce` emitting final.json; the task instruction reconciles the deliverable to scripts/aggregate-evidence.sh emitting summary.json. Same reducer role, reconciled output path.

what_built: A jq-based evidence reducer (no new dependencies; python3 jsonschema is unavailable in this environment) that: (1) verifies every plan todo 1..34 has an evidence file that parses as JSON; (2) classifies each todo into deterministic/privileged/benchmark/meta lanes via a documented lane map derived from schemas/README.md and each todo's verification character; (3) extracts a lane-aware outcome from the heterogeneous per-task evidence using the project's fail-closed outcome vocabulary; (4) validates the dedicated lane artifacts (task-27-benchmark.json -> evidence-benchmark.v1.json, task-28-warm.json -> warm-http-demo.v1.json) against their schemas' fail-closed invariants via targeted jq checks (class discriminator, required keys, additionalProperties:false, anti-mock allOf, anti-boolean not-required, summary arithmetic); (5) emits the unified verification matrix at summary.json.

lane_map.rationale: deterministic = reproducible across hosts (types, state machine, policy, contract, path/digest validation, transport parity, scheduler pure logic, OCI importer, CLI, snapshot manifest, direct-KVM contract docs, operator docs); privileged = exercises real /dev/kvm, /dev/net/tun, cgroup-v2 mutation, Firecracker/jailer, TAP/netns, snapshot/restore; benchmark = latency distributions + Docker cold/warm + warm HTTP demo; meta = environment bootstrap, evidence-schema definition, this aggregation, and the release-readiness matrix.

fail_closed_semantics_enforced.anti_mock: A privileged pass is accepted ONLY on affirmative real-substrate proof (privileged_boot_evidence.real_boot_outcome.outcome==completed, or a privileged_run with pass==true && blocked==false). host_preflight.kvm_ok==false forces blocked even against a claimed real boot (the check precedes real-substrate proof so a fabricated boot cannot evade it). A privileged todo with only status:complete and no real-substrate proof is reported blocked (privileged_not_demonstrated_on_host), never promoted to pass.
fail_closed_semantics_enforced.anti_boolean: Benchmark artifacts are validated to carry no `pass` field at top level or in any item (additionalProperties:false + explicit not-required). Benchmark outcomes are published (distributions recorded) or blocked only; the reducer refuses to count a benchmark as pass.
fail_closed_semantics_enforced.deterministic_no_blocked: The deterministic lane has no blocked state; a blocked deterministic todo is flagged as a semantic violation (deterministic_blocked_not_allowed) and counted as fail.
fail_closed_semantics_enforced.never_erase_blocked: An explicit blocked signal (blocked_reason, verdict==blocked, summary.blocked>0 with pass==0, or a BlockedReason token in privileged evidence) always yields a blocked outcome; blocked evidence is preserved, never overwritten.
fail_closed_semantics_enforced.missing_is_failure: A todo with no evidence artifact is outcome=missing and, in strict mode (default), makes the reducer exit 1 naming the task number and missing path.

reducer_runs.details: Produces summary.json; coverage 33/34 after this evidence lands (todo 34 pending).

strict_mode.details: Default strict mode exits 1 while any todo lacks evidence (missing artifact is a failure), as todo 33 acceptance requires.

all_evidence_valid_json.command: for f in .omo/evidence/kvm-microvm-orchestrator/task-*.json; do jq -e . "$f" >/dev/null || echo "INVALID $f"; done
all_evidence_valid_json.details: All 33 present task evidence files plus the two lane artifacts parse as JSON; the reducer parse-checks each and would mark an invalid file outcome=invalid + exit 1.

lane_artifacts_conform_to_schemas.details: task-27-benchmark.json validates against evidence-benchmark.v1.json (class=benchmark, required top-level keys, no pass field, host_metadata/workload/benchmarks nested requirements, runtime_versions empty-object valid for a fully-blocked bench). task-28-warm.json validates against warm-http-demo.v1.json (class=warm_http_demo, exactly the 16 required keys, no pass field, blocked_reason null). summary.schema_validation.all_valid=true and arithmetic_reconciled=true (every summary object satisfies total==pass+fail[+blocked]).

aggregation_result.host_context: Host has /dev/kvm (api 12, nested), /dev/net/tun, unified cgroup-v2, but runs non-root and lacks firecracker/jailer binaries. Therefore the only privileged todo with affirmative real-substrate proof is task-30 (direct-KVM educational subset booted a marker guest on real KVM: serial byte 0x4B 'K', stop=hlt). Every Firecracker/cgroup/netns privileged verification is reported blocked, not pass. Benchmark task-27 (snapshot/Docker) is blocked (firecracker_missing, docker_missing); task-28 warm HTTP demo ran and is published (distributions only, no pass field).

acceptance_criteria.reducer_emits_structured_matrix: summary.json carries deterministic pass/fail, privileged pass/blocked/fail, and benchmark published/blocked sections (benchmark has pass:0 + pass_forbidden:true).
acceptance_criteria.missing_artifact_is_failure: Deleting a required artifact makes the reducer exit 1 with the task number and missing path; strict default exits 1 while todo 34 is missing.
acceptance_criteria.benchmark_has_no_pass_field: Both benchmark artifacts validate with no pass field; the reducer flags any smuggled pass field as a violation.
acceptance_criteria.all_task_artifacts_validate_before_reduc: Every evidence file is parse-checked; the two lane artifacts are schema-validated; summary arithmetic is reconciled.

exclusions_honored: no blocked evidence erased: all 14 blocked outcomes (11 privileged, 1 benchmark, 2 meta) are preserved with their reasons
no pass fabricated: privileged pass requires real-substrate proof (only task-30); a kvm_ok=false mock is downgraded to blocked; benchmark never records pass
todo 34 reported missing honestly, not promoted to pass
no new dependencies added (jq-only; python3 jsonschema unavailable)
reducer is read-only over evidence: it only writes the summary report
not_tested: full draft-2020-12 JSON Schema validation (no jsonschema library available); schema conformance is checked via targeted jq assertions of each schema's fail-closed invariants instead
privileged todos that only record status:complete are conservatively reported blocked; a real-but-unrecorded privileged pass would read as blocked until real-substrate evidence is added
the reducer does not re-run any test suite; it aggregates recorded evidence only (running the suites is todo 34's release-readiness matrix)
